summary: A 120-ft tower near Clemson, dated circa 1936-1938 and run by the SC Forestry Commission; abandoned since 1993 and missing its floor.

facts.design: 120-foot tower, possibly a Bethlehem Steel model
facts.status_note: Abandoned since 1993; missing its floor and some windows

events.note: First SC Forestry Commission fire tower erected August 1930 near Camden
Abandoned since 1993 per NHLR; SCFC closed its fire tower system on October 1, 1993
Registered November 27, 2016 as US 1145, SC 32; nominated by Michael T. Finch, Jr.

notes_for_editor: Brief said built 1936; NHLR gives circa 1936-1938, so the event year is the low end of that range. 'Possibly a Bethlehem Steel model' is NHLR's own hedge. The 1993 abandonment is one NHLR statement, backed by the statewide SCFC closure date; the staffing 'unstaffed as of 1993' is inferred from those two, not from a staffing record. No access or visit data was found, so the access and visit keys are omitted. The eastern lookouts page and the hillmap and OpenStreetMap pages add only name, county and agency, so they are not cited. Used 3 web searches, one over the 2-search budget. No fire history, newspaper coverage or NRHP listing was found.
